items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Eddie is the guy's name. Eddie is the guy that brought his wife in, Eddie Scarf, S-C-A-R-F.

ctx.x: one girl has got this arm and one girl has got that arm, they won't let me go to the door. I finally get away from the girls. I think they had an iron there, a smoothing iron, that the girls press things with. I think there was an iron there somewhere that I took this iron and I was going to hit this guy with the iron from where I was sitting. But anyway I didn't throw the iron, I got up and went to the door and just went all over the girls standing there holding the door and grabbed this fella. Now up the…

So this guy don't know that I'm set on these things to do. He's set on going through the motions I was going through, you know. He was caught in the middle of his trap. Okay. So the girls got to get me up and get me in the house and let the guys get away from the door.

So now we're going to whip this guy that's in the show because he's the one that told the fellas. So the next day we plan on getting him. I let Buck take care of him because Buck was for him. Eddie is the guy's name. Eddie is the guy that brought his wife in, Eddie Scarf, S-C-A-R-F.
